about: Model -> Loom card for 1bit serve's GPU route (docs/loom-route.md). A .gguf served on the GPU (--device auto or hrx) whose entry matches runs on loom-serve (AMD's Loom programs on the HRX runtime); every other model runs on the llama.cpp fork's llama-server as before. An entry is added only after the model passed the Loom-vs-fallback gate (interleaved A/B speed and accuracy on strixhalo, docs/loom-route.md "Gate"), with the gate's result linked in `gate`.

Accuracy gate row (strixhalo, hrx-loom 0.3.0, served --preset=chat --pool_backing=fixed, CPU arbiter on the weight-equivalent GGUF): https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/engine/issues/3158#issuecomment-7216723223 - near-tie rule 8/8 (identical 4, near-tie splits 4 at 0.036/0.045/0.05/0.256 nats), known answers 6/6; decode 90.7-91.1 tok/s and 16k prefill 2,085-2,094 tok/s, equal to the afcb64b0 re-card's row https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/engine/issues/3158#issuecomment-7140433770; mean KLD vs the HF reference 0.004583 vs 0.004571 (engine#3333). No fallback arm exists (the llama.cpp-HRX port is refused under strict placement)
